candidates.category_order: inside a category, content classes sorted by rank('candidate', seed, target occurrence_id, object_id); first N kept
candidates.category_semantics: same_path_historical = same family, member_path and offset; same_family_decoy = same family, other position; foreign_family_decoy = other family in the same split
candidates.representative: smallest eligible occurrence_id of the content class

duplicates.aliases: all occurrences are kept; a content class counts once in C_t
duplicates.cross_split_content: content present in more than one split is excluded as base and target and reported
duplicates.identity_only_targets: target bytes equal to an eligible base -> status identity_only, no pairs, does not consume max_targets
duplicates.occurrence_identity: occurrence_id = sha256 compact JSON ['delsk.occurrence.v1', source_id, provenance]

member_rules.glob_semantics: fnmatch.fnmatchcase on the member path relative to the archive root after stripping one top-level directory; '*' also matches '/'
member_rules.selection_key: rank('member', seed, family_id, path) = sha256 of compact canonical JSON; smallest wins per (release, stratum); release is not part of the key

on_cap_violation: fail; a reviewed new lock is required; no hidden trimming
scorer_visibility_note: relatedness categories, family, path, release and time are audit-only until a separate deployment metadata policy is declared

splits.on_component_count_mismatch: stop sealing; review the source policy; never redistribute silently
splits.order: components sorted by rank('split', seed, smallest family_id); counts filled in order
splits.transforms: every derived representation inherits the split of its source release
splits.unit: ancestry component (families joined by merge edges)

strata_semantics: half-open [min_bytes, max_bytes); missing strata stay empty, no substitutes

targets.order: groups (family_id, track, stratum) sorted by rank('target-group', seed, family_id, track, stratum or ''); inside a group occurrences sorted by rank('target', seed, occurrence_id); take one per group per round until max_targets near_duplicate targets or exhaustion

time_rule.eligibility: base.hi < target.lo; unknown time is temporally ineligible both as base and target
time_rule.source: upstream publication evidence only; acquisition time and file mtimes are never release time

track_rules.canonical_tar_gzip_v1: canonical_tar_v1 compressed by Python gzip, compresslevel from the track, mtime 0, empty filename; provenance options {compresslevel, zlib_runtime} and lock toolchain.zlib_runtime must match, so a different zlib runtime yields a different occurrence_id
track_rules.canonical_tar_v1: ustar of all retained members of one release, sorted by path, mode 0644, uid/gid 0, empty uname/gname, mtime 0, no directories
track_rules.chunk_offsets: fixed offsets 0, unit, 2*unit, ...; a short tail below unit_bytes is excluded as short_tail, never padded
track_rules.lanes: historical = bytes published upstream; modeled = deterministic representations built by materialize.py; results are never pooled across lanes
track_rules.member_less_categories: for tar and tar-gz the position key is (family, null, null): earlier releases of the same family are same_path_historical (at most two)
